```{python}
def median(numbers):
    numbers.sort()
    n = len(numbers)
    if (n % 2) == 1:
        m = numbers[int((n + 1) / 2)]
    else:
        m = (numbers[int(n/2-1)] + numbers[int(n/2)]) / 2
    return m


number_list = [3, 4, 5, 2, 8, 1, 6, 7]
med = median(number_list)
print(f"The median of {number_list} is {med}")
```
